What: Touches the icon on the top. The plastic there is 0.8 mm thin
Copper ring under each icon; chip U2 (AT42QT1070) feels the finger. KEY0 Power, KEY1 Previous, KEY2 Next, KEY3 Light
TB J1 to light ring RB J2: 1 5V, 2 GND, 3 icon LED data, 4 SDA, 5 SCL, 6 CHANGE. Moves with the top
Copper tracks carry the signals from the front plug J2 to the rear plug J1
RB J1 to main board J7: 1-2 5V, 3-4 GND, 5 ring LED data, 6 SDA, 7 SCL, 8 CHANGE. The coil stretches as the top moves
ESP32 reads SDA on GPIO8, SCL on GPIO9, CHANGE on GPIO6; ring and icon LED data leaves on GPIO39
Power: on/off. Previous / Next: change screen page. Light: change effect
